boundary: Editorial and semantic review controls grounded in saved reviewed examples. Proposed excerpts are not new accepted scientific outputs. No model assessment of these controls has been run.

proposed_excerpt.before: Earlier FAIRE DNA is amplified, labeled and read by comparative microarrays.
proposed_excerpt.after: The later paper uses gel-purified approximately 200 bp FAIRE DNA for adapter ligation, PCR library amplification and Illumina sequencing. The readout change is specified even though no historical donor for this sequencing-library interface is established.

cases.bad_text: The sequencing chemistry is unknown because no sequencing-library ancestor was identified; alternatively R3 must have supplied it to fill the required parent field.
cases.expectation: Independently review this existing-type design record at method level without requiring a library-donor claim. The R3 FAIRE-selection inheritance can refer to the relevant contribution, but must not acquire ancestry for its untransferred sequencing interface. No claim of global first invention follows. A free-text summary alone is not independently reviewed structured contribution coverage.
retrieval_targets: Review check addressed to the method-level design-change ID

proposed_excerpt.before: UV crosslinking, partial RNA digestion and RBP immunopurification recover protein-bound RNA after gel/membrane separation and proteinase K treatment.
proposed_excerpt.after: eCLIP retains this capture/purification route; the recovered RNA enters its changed library-conversion route. No change to this reused capture feature is established.

cases.bad_text: eCLIP improves UV capture by applying it to different RBPs and cells.
cases.expectation: Accept unchanged reuse if both-source support and later attribution hold. Revise the invented capture benefit. Sample context alone does not demonstrate a changed capture mechanism.

proposed_excerpt.before: An RT primer supplies inverse adapter regions; self-circularization and BamHI reopening make the truncated cDNA amplifiable.
proposed_excerpt.after: eCLIP retains recovery of truncated cDNA but directly ligates a second ssDNA adapter to its 3-prime end after RT, replacing circularization and restriction reopening.

cases.bad_text: Earlier iCLIP analyzed hnRNP C in HeLa cells. Later eCLIP profiled RBFOX2 and many RBPs using efficient library preparation.
cases.expectation: The explicit same-boundary replacement is a positive clarity control. Revise two independently true assay summaries that fail to state the design difference.

proposed_excerpt.before: The original iCLIP RT primer carries a three-base molecular tag; identical genomic endpoint and tag identify PCR copies.
proposed_excerpt.after: eCLIP puts N5/N10 in the post-RT ssDNA adapter and deduplicates by the two read starts plus random-mer.

cases.expectation: Accept the supported tagging design comparison with unknown isolated gain. Do not require a benefit or a first-introduction claim.
retrieval_targets: Later iCLIP protocol only if a priority/version claim is made

cases.bad_text: Moving the random tag to rand3Tr3 caused the approximately 1000-fold increase in adapter-ligated material.
cases.expectation: Revise/reject the isolated causal attribution. A valid source quotation and whole-assay result cannot establish the effect of this one change. Do not replace this with a statement that the tag has no benefit; the benefit is unknown.
retrieval_targets: Experiment defining the actual iCLIP baseline
Any true tag-only ablation, if found

proposed_excerpt.metric: Usable-read fraction at matched uniquely mapped read depth

cases.bad_text: Comparator: usable reads; eCLIP improved this inherited component relative to the original König dataset.
cases.expectation: Name the actual local baseline separately from the measured quantity and historical endpoint. The saved whole-assay result is not a causal component gain.

proposed_excerpt.before: Bulk ATAC tags nuclear chromatin and PCR-amplifies one population library.
proposed_excerpt.after: The later assay tags nuclei in first-round wells, pools and redistributes intact nuclei, then lyses and indexes in second-round PCR wells. The index pair provides probable cell attribution while accessibility-directed insertion is retained.

cases.bad_text: scATAC invents more sensitive Tn5 chemistry by adding cell barcodes.
cases.expectation: Accept the supported material/routing/assay-unit change. Revise the unestablished new-chemistry or sensitivity claim.
retrieval_targets: First tagging, pooling, sorting, lysis and second PCR order

cases.bad_text: The C1 capture component, transposition component, barcoding component and release component each improve sensitivity by more than 500-fold.
cases.expectation: Revise duplicated component benefits. Preserve the reported whole-assay input-sensitivity comparison once, with its published bulk benchmark and sparse-cell coverage qualification.

cases.bad_text: The single-cell method newly eliminates DNA purification after transposition, which the earlier ATAC method always required.
cases.expectation: Revise: the earlier 500/5000-cell ATAC variant already transferred transposition directly into PCR. Describe the supported release optimization separately.
retrieval_targets: Later Extended Data Figure 1 release experiment

cases.bad_text: SDS is the final on-chip Tn5-release reagent because it dissociates Tn5-DNA in the gel-shift test.
cases.expectation: Require decisive Methods/condition-table evidence for implemented chemistry. If unavailable, leave this detail unknown; do not block the independent cell-assay claim merely to fill a reagent name.
retrieval_targets: Extended Data Figure 1 table and caption

proposed_excerpt.metric: Mean nuclear-genome fragments per passing chamber

cases.expectation: Accept absolute reported capability with quality-filtered context. Do not infer improvement or demand a fictitious baseline.

proposed_excerpt.before: FAIRE aqueous DNA is amplified, fluorescently labeled and comparatively hybridized to microarrays.
proposed_excerpt.after: FAIRE-selected DNA instead supplies an adapter-ligated, amplified Illumina sequencing library; this changes readout while retaining selection.

cases.bad_text: FAIRE was not extracted because its method card is missing, so a new FAIRE-Seq card must be added.
cases.expectation: Reject the missing-card/extraction-failure diagnosis. The grouped FAIRE-Seq/Sono-Seq card and focal sequencing extraction exist. Preserve raw exact-version match findings, flag the earlier array version for identity review, and do not overwrite the focal scope.
retrieval_targets: Grouped card and curated source assignments

cases.bad_text: High concordance with tiling arrays proves that sequencing improves FAIRE sensitivity over the yeast predecessor.
cases.expectation: Revise: the same-sample tiling-array concordance is validation, without a demonstrated sensitivity gain over the cited earlier implementation.

cases.bad_text: Resolve M-SPA to NOMe-seq or WGBS because each uses bisulfite sequencing.
cases.expectation: Reject the forced endpoint join. Preserve the publication-bound M-SPA name as an absent implementation and the relation as mechanistic precedent; the known later method does not establish identity or transfer.
retrieval_targets: Earlier M.SssI intact-nucleus footprinting and promoter readout

cases.bad_text: The purified-DNA Nextera library method is the whole single-cell accessibility assay and introduced its chromatin selectivity.
cases.expectation: Reject whole-assay expansion, but retain supported Tn5 fragmentation/adapter-tagging component use. Exact donor-operation extraction and a demonstrated isolated gain are unnecessary.

cases.bad_text: GRO-seq inherited Seila's short-RNA library chemistry and improved it through BrUTP enrichment.
cases.expectation: Reject invented transfer and temporal precedence. Preserve comparison of selected RNA/readout and the source-qualified corroboration rationale. Unavailable comparator library chemistry stays unknown.
retrieval_targets: Comparator supplement only if claiming its exact chemistry

cases.bad_text: The bulk ATAC reference is an ancestor, so every result comparison to it is also inheritance and a gain.
cases.expectation: Reject the paper-level role collapse. Retain the comparison-only 13–55% expected-complexity result and its null/downside interpretation, independently of the separate ATAC inheritance claim.
